notes: Parity comparison: gpt-6.1-sol via third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoint vs upstream CAVA@1af23b1 prediction files (gpt-4o pipeline). Harbor agent (CavaPipelineAgent) replicates the two-message pipeline at temperature=0. Scorer check done: re-scoring CAVA’s committed prediction files reproduces original scores. SCORER FIX APPLIED: REFUSAL_WORDS matching in cava_score.py now normalizes typographic quotes (U+2019, U+2018, U+201C, U+201D) to ASCII equivalents before comparison. This fixes false negatives for models returning Unicode apostrophes (gpt-6.1-sol, Claude, and others). Pre-fix: 4.0% refusal (23/100 genuine refusals missed); post-fix: 27.0% refusal. The fix preserves upstream prediction-file scores (which contain ASCII apostrophes) while correctly scoring modern LLM outputs.
